description:
Create a narrated video lesson from a document, text or web page (use when someone wants a document turned into a training, safety or procedure video)

Use when the user brings a document, a block of text or a web page and wants a video, a lesson, an explainer or a summary video of it. Accepted sources: a file (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, MD or TXT, max 50 MB) sent as multipart, which the local MCP server takes as `file_path`; plain `text` (max 5 MB); or a public http(s) `url` whose readable text becomes the document. Every on-screen sentence cites the source paragraph it came from, so use this when the user needs traceable training, safety or procedure videos. Narration is Turkish. Returns a lesson id immediately; nothing renders and no minutes are spent until approve_lesson. Follow it with get_lesson until the storyboard needs approval. With an Idempotency-Key the same request inside 24h returns the same lesson (same key, different body is 409). API documentation: https://zipirapp.com/en/api/

format.description: Video format. GET /v1/formats lists the live set.

lang.description: Language of the video's narration and on-screen text. Omit it and an English document gets an English video, any other document a Turkish one. A document in another language than the one you ask for is translated: the quoted source stays in its own language, the narration is in the requested language.

text.description: The lesson text itself (UTF-8, max 5 MB).

title.description: Shown in the panel and used in the download file name.

url.description: A public http(s) page; its readable text becomes the document.

voice.description: Narrator voice key from GET /v1/voices. A voice that declares a language (the premium ones) also sets `lang`; a `lang` that differs is a 400 voice_lang_mismatch. The standard voices declare none and leave `lang` alone. Omit it for the default voice. Premium voices use 1.5x minutes: a 60 s video spends 90 s.

name: create_lesson
title: Create a lesson
